verdict: Meta is delivering leads at pace; Google spend is being addressed now.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, all 82 leads came from Meta at a cost of $9.59 per lead, while Google Ads spent $2,377 and produced zero leads — a confirmed issue, not a tracking gap. Meta's momentum is accelerating, with 26 leads recorded across just the last three days of the window. Google's budget is being redirected while the root cause of its zero-conversion performance is resolved. You should expect lead volume to hold or grow next period as the corrected budget allocation takes effect, and we are working to ensure leads entering your pipeline move through to booked appointments.
